description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa along the right exterior wall facing inward toward the living space; armchair near upper living zone facing the dining area. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing significant storage (no wardrobe, very limited storage); people requiring a home office (no desk and limited dedicated space); shared living between unrelated adults (single bedroom only).
